legacy_corrections.text: PROCEDURE CODE TYPE (Dental / Medical / Other, all three ticked by default) selects the code families that are included in the printout.

CATEGORY, PRODUCTION TYPE, STATUS and the three Include Only boxes work as on Procedure Codes List: one ADA category, one scheduler production type, code status, and tooth-required / surface-required / bill-to-insurance codes only.

FEE SCHEDULE takes one schedule: there is no ALL default here - a specific schedule is preselected (the name in our capture is tenant data, not a fixed default). Whether the list holds an ALL entry at all is not stated.
This report is the vendor's documented way to print an office (UCR) fee schedule or a contracted PPO fee schedule: that schedule is the one picked under FEE SCHEDULE.

EFFECTIVE DATE picks one effective-dated version of the chosen fee schedule. It came with the Effective Date feature (2020); before that the schedule dropdown itself carried the date as a suffix [ED: m/d/yyyy] after the schedule name.

Office versus Office Group. The Office Group option is greyed on Routing Slip and the four Ledger reports (mode locked to office); the whole control is greyed on Referral Source List.

108 = id of the office the user was working in. Offices (mode office) or office groups (mode office_group). Vendor documentation: Office = one or more offices the user can access (default the logged-in office); Office Group = groups from Setup > Office Groups (default ALL). Greyed (locked to the working office) on the four Ledger reports and display-only on Referral Source List. The selection becomes exactly one of the value keys office_ids / office_group_id / office_group_ids; tokens working_office, my_offices; all = every office (or group) the caller may read.

dynamic_rules.legacy_effect: The SELECT picker chooses office groups defined in Setup > Office Groups (for example regions) instead of offices; when no office groups are defined, a group run covers all offices of the account. Cross-cutting statement of the document for all Lists screens (vendor articles on office groups and on the new reports menu) - recorded once here; it applies to the three Setup List reports that have the Office / Office Group radios (Office List, Office Holidays, Operatory List).

legacy_corrections.text: The number in the office box is not a fixed default: with the Office radio the box defaults to the current office (the OID of the session, the same number the title bar shows) and SELECT picks other offices.
